info.title: Prefetch API
info.description: Extract brand identity, company data, screenshots, IAB classifications, and clean page content from any URL.

apiKey.name: X-API-Key
apiKey.description: Your Prefetch API key. Obtain one from the dashboard.

durationMs.description: Time taken to process the request in milliseconds.

CodeColorItem.description: One color scraped from the page's CSS, HTML, or JavaScript.

color.description: The raw value as written on the page.

group.description: Nearest named color, used as the group key.

distance.description: Distance to that named color. 0 is an exact match.

name.description: Tint label within the group, ordered nearest-first.

hex.description: The color as a hex triplet.

source.description: Where the color came from. Present on `screenshot_colors` entries only.

brand_colors.description: The brand palette, built from the logo and brand assets. Always present.

code_colors.description: Colors scraped from the page's code, keyed by nearest named color. Present only when `css=true`, `html=true`, or `javascript=true`. Sources are merged into one map, not split per source.

screenshot_colors.description: Dominant colors sampled from the screenshot. Present only when `screenshotColors=N` is passed.

families.description: Font family names detected on the page.

url.description: Public URL to the logo asset.

width.description: Intrinsic width of the logo in pixels.

height.description: Intrinsic height of the logo in pixels.

primary.description: Best candidate for the primary logo.

secondary.description: Other logo candidates found on the page.

apple_touch_icon.description: URL to the Apple Touch Icon.

BrandAssetItem.description: An image harvested from the site or its social profiles, such as a Twitter banner.

assets.description: Additional brand imagery found on the site and its social profiles.

screenshot_url.description: URL to the page screenshot stored in cloud storage.

SocialLinks.description: Social media profile URLs keyed by platform name.

BrandBlock.description: Brand identity extracted from the page.

domain.description: Normalized domain extracted from the URL.

ClassificationBlock.description: IAB classification of the site. Null in `/enrich` when classification failed.

description.description: Short human-readable description of the website.

long_description.description: Extended multi-sentence description of the website.

stock_tickers.description: Stock ticker symbols associated with the company, if publicly traded.

isins.description: ISIN codes associated with the company's securities.

domain.description: Normalized domain extracted from the URL.

name.description: Legal entity name of the company.

emails.description: Contact email addresses found on the site.

addresses.description: Physical addresses found on the site.
example: 354 Oyster Point Blvd, South San Francisco, CA 94080

screenshot_url.description: Public URL to the screenshot stored in cloud storage.

full_page.description: Whether the full scrollable height was captured.

captured_at.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the screenshot was taken.

EnrichBrandBlock.description: The same brand block `/brand` returns, without `social_links` — in `/enrich` those live on `company` instead.

EnrichData.description: Combined output from brand, company, and classify extraction. Each block sits under the same key the standalone endpoint uses.

ScrapeMetadata.description: Always present, whatever formats were requested.

robots.description: The page's own robots meta tag.

headings.description: The page's heading outline, up to 100 entries.

content.description: GitHub Flavored Markdown. Links and images are resolved to absolute URLs.

truncated.description: True when the content hit the 1 MB size cap and was cut.

main_content_only.description: True when boilerplate was successfully isolated away. False means the full page body was returned.

text.description: Null when the summary could not be produced; see `warnings`.

internal.description: Links on the same site, subdomains included.

data.description: The extracted object, shaped by your prompt or schema.

warnings.description: Non-fatal problems, such as a format that could not be produced.

ScrapePayload.description: The page content fields. Which of them are present depends on the `formats` requested.

lastmod.description: From the sitemap, when the site publishes one.

CrawlScrapeOptions.description: How each crawled page is rendered. The same options `GET /scrape` takes.

max_depth.description: How many links deep to follow from the start URL. Sitemap-seeded pages sit at depth 0, so `max_depth: 0` with `use_sitemap: true` crawls exactly what the sitemap lists and follows nothing.

include_paths.description: Regular expressions matched against a URL's path and query. A URL must match at least one to be crawled.

exclude_paths.description: Regular expressions. A URL matching any of them is skipped. Exclusions win over inclusions.

allow_subdomains.description: Follow links onto subdomains of the start URL.

ignore_query_params.description: Treat URLs that differ only by query string as one page.

respect_robots_txt.description: Obey the rules in `robots.txt` — Disallow and Crawl-delay. Sitemap discovery happens either way.

use_sitemap.description: Seed the crawl from the site's sitemap as well as from links.

delay_ms.description: Politeness delay between pages. A larger `Crawl-delay` in robots.txt wins.

expires_at.description: After this, the crawl and its pages are no longer readable.

CrawlPage.description: One crawled page. Carries the same fields `GET /scrape` returns, plus the crawl's own bookkeeping.

depth.description: How many links from the start URL. Sitemap-seeded pages are depth 0.

ok.description: False when the page could not be fetched. You are not charged for it.

total.description: Pages the crawl expects to fetch, as currently known. Rises as it discovers more.

next.description: URL for the next page of results, or null when there are no more.

url.name: url
url.description: The website URL to process. `https://` is prepended automatically if no protocol is provided.

screenshotWidth.name: width
screenshotWidth.description: Viewport width in pixels. Range: 320–2560. Default: 1440.

screenshotHeight.name: height
screenshotHeight.description: Viewport height in pixels. Range: 240–5000. Default: 900.

screenshotFullPage.name: full_page
screenshotFullPage.description: Capture full scrollable page height. Default: `false`.

scrapeFormats.name: formats
scrapeFormats.description: Comma-separated list of output formats. Each requested format appears as its own object on `data`; formats you do not request are absent, not null.

onlyMainContent.name: only_main_content
onlyMainContent.description: Strip navigation, sidebars, footers, and cookie banners before rendering `markdown`, `html`, `summary`, and `json`. `links` and `images` always come from the full document.

includeLinks.name: include_links
includeLinks.description: Keep hyperlinks in the `markdown` and `html` output. When false, link text is kept and the target is dropped.

includeImages.name: include_images
includeImages.description: Keep images in the `markdown` and `html` output.

includeBase64Images.name: include_base64_images
includeBase64Images.description: Keep inline `data:` images. Off by default because base64 payloads are large and carry no meaning as text.

includeSelectors.name: include_selectors
includeSelectors.description: Comma-separated CSS selectors to keep. Overrides main-content detection entirely.

excludeSelectors.name: exclude_selectors
excludeSelectors.description: Comma-separated CSS selectors to remove before rendering.

jsonPrompt.name: json_prompt
jsonPrompt.description: What to extract, in plain language. Required for the `json` format unless `json_schema` is given.

jsonSchema.name: json_schema
jsonSchema.description: A JSON Schema, passed as a JSON string, describing the object the `json` format should return.

mapLimit.name: limit
mapLimit.description: Maximum number of links to return.

mapSearch.name: search
mapSearch.description: Rank and filter results by relevance to this query. Links that match nothing are dropped.

mapSitemap.name: sitemap
mapSitemap.description: Which sources to use. `include` merges sitemap entries with on-page links, `skip` uses on-page links only, `only` uses sitemaps only.

mapIncludeSubdomains.name: include_subdomains
mapIncludeSubdomains.description: Include links on subdomains of the target.

mapIgnoreQueryParams.name: ignore_query_params
mapIgnoreQueryParams.description: Treat URLs that differ only by query string as one page.

crawlSkip.name: skip
crawlSkip.description: Number of result pages to skip. Use the `next` link rather than building this by hand.

crawlPageLimit.name: limit
crawlPageLimit.description: Number of crawled pages to return per request.

Runs brand extraction, company info extraction, and website classification in parallel and returns all results in a single response. **Credit cost: 20.**

This is the most comprehensive endpoint — equivalent to calling `/brand`, `/company`, and `/classify` together but more efficient because the page is only loaded once.

post.description:
Queues a breadth-first crawl and returns its id immediately. Crawls run for minutes, so nothing waits on this request — poll `GET /crawl/{id}` for progress and results.

**Credit cost: 3 to submit, plus 3 per page the crawl returns.** Pages are charged as they complete, so you pay for what was fetched rather than for the `limit` you asked for.

get.description:
Returns progress plus a page of crawled pages, oldest first. Follow `next` until it is null to read every page. Results stay readable for 24 hours after the crawl finishes.

This is also where crawled pages are billed: each call charges for the pages that completed since the previous call, so polling repeatedly never charges twice for the same page.
